text:
maria: Heads up — found a weird binding in audit logs: project:analytics in org:acme has an extra role 'workspace/viewer' granted by svc-account 'svc-boundary-sync'.
ryan: ugh, that's not expected. is that from the nightly policy-migration run?
maria: looks like it. timestamps show reconcile at 03:14 UTC and then a second pass at 03:16. same svc-account.
samira: can you paste the log entry (obfuscated)?
maria: log: `actor: svc-boundary-sync@infra-prod, action: setBinding, target: projects/analytics, binding: {role: "workspace/viewer", members: ["group:acme-qa@redwood.com"]}`
oliver: svc-boundary-sync was supposed to only touch project-scoped roles, not org-level crossbinds. might be a state-desync in boundary-guard.
ryan: deploying a hotfix to the sync job now to add an explicit org->project guard. rolling to staging first.
security-bot: alert — unusual cross-scope binding created. Creating incident incident-2026-03-20-01.
maria: I've revoked the offending binding and noted affected principals. ran: `rbacctl revoke --project analytics --binding workspace/viewer --source svc-boundary-sync`
samira: good. can we confirm no KMS access was granted due to this? need to check decrypt/encrypt logs for the same service account.
oliver: KMS audit shows no decrypt calls from group:acme-qa during that window. only a lookup from platform-monitoring.
ryan: hotfix passed staging smoke and I'm starting canary in prod (2 nodes). will gate if any more cross-scope writes show up.
maria: created a query to list recent setBinding events where actor matches svc-boundary-sync and scope != intended_scope. will run hourly for 24h.
ops-bot: scheduled job `boundary-guard-audit` created, runs hourly for 24 hours.
samira: need a follow-up: change the migration tool to validate memberships against org whitelist before applying. also add unit tests for scope validation.
oliver: agree. also add integration test that simulates missing sync-state to ensure it doesn't default to global scope.
ryan: root cause blurb so far: a state reconciliation edge-case where an absent entry in the new mapping caused the code to fallback and attach a last-known-binding at org scope.
maria: filing a vuln-triage ticket with recommended fix, rollback snapshot, and customer notification draft.
samira: pinging legal to check disclosure requirements for affected customers.
security-bot: incident-2026-03-20-01 updated: status=investigating, severity=high, owner=eng-security.
ryan: will open PR for hotfix and link to the incident. PR will include rollout blocker that stops if >3 unique orgs see unexpected changes.
maria: thanks — I'll coordinate customer comms and run a full audit of service-accounts that can perform setBinding.
oliver: postmortem TODOs: (1) stricter scope validation, (2) add canary run to migration jobs, (3) KMS access double-check, (4) improve alerting to include "scope mismatch" classification.
samira: assigning follow-ups and ETA 48h for patch + tests.
maria: closing loop here once canary finishes. :thumbsup:
ryan: canary green at +15m, promoting hotfix to full rollout now. will monitor.
ops-bot: deploy job boundary-sync-hotfix finished: success.
security-bot: incident-2026-03-20-01 status=mitigated (binding revoked, hotfix deployed, monitoring active).
